mapper.sql: id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, component, permission_code, icon, sort_order, visible, status, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM sys_menu WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.path, m.component, m.permission_code, m.icon, m.sort_order, m.visible, m.status, m.remark, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.deleted FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort_order ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu ( parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, component, permission_code, icon, sort_order, visible, status, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{path}, #{component}, #{permissionCode}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{visible}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_type = #{menuType}, path = #{path}, component = #{component}, permission_code = #{permissionCode}, icon = #{icon}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, visible = #{visible}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_menu SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
